input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts
The issue is that the password reset email link uses BASE_URL which defaults to "http://localhost:3000" if PUBLIC_URL environment variable is not set. The code is here: `const BASE_URL = process.env.PUBLIC_URL ?? "http://localhost:3000";`. To fix this bug, the deployment environment must ensure that PUBLIC_URL is correctly set to the production URL so the email does not contain localhost links.
